name: Mage Slayer (Combat)
body:
You have dedicated your skills and tactics to combat spellcasters.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 2 ranks, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit: You gain a +1 bonus in Will saving throws against spells or spell-like abilities.

Spellcasters you threaten may not cast defensively. The spellcaster is aware of this by your demeanor and if they still try the attempt automatically fails. The spellcaster is immune to this feat if they are 4 or more levels higher than you.
